name: Scene Scale Consistency Scoring
definition: A heuristic to detect artifacts that are coherent with relevant scene geometry by comparing occupancy grids from models trained with different aabb_scale factors. It relies on the intuition that relevant geometry position is invariant to aabb_scale changes, while artifacts manifest in slightly different regions.
summary: Scene Scale Consistency Scoring detects floating artifacts in neural radiance fields by filtering occupancy grids inconsistent across different bounding box scales before clustering.
